intro: Eswatini is a small landlocked country between South Africa and Mozambique.

chapters.title: Land
text: The country steps down from western highlands to the eastern lowveld. Sibebe Rock is one of the largest granite domes in the world. Mlilwane and Hlane parks protect wildlife.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The highlands are cool and wet, the lowveld hot.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Eswatini's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
